issues.body: `cmd_reason` still prints `usage: sparq-cli reason <data-file> <format> <rdfs|owl|n3> [out.nt]` even though `el` is accepted, and the top-level fallback still omits both the existing `reason` command and feature-gated `classify`. Since `skills/cli/SKILL.md` says there is no `--help` and users discover commands through these usage errors, the executable contradicts its documented public surface. The added tests still do not exercise either path.
issues.fix_hint: Add `el` to `cmd_reason`'s missing-argument usage. Add `reason` to top-level usage and conditionally advertise `classify <data-file> <format> [out.nt]` under `reason-el`. Add subprocess assertions for `reason` with missing arguments and for feature-enabled top-level usage.
issues.title: The no-help CLI still omits EL surfaces from its usage contract

verdict.summary: Round 5 is stagnant: the sole round-4 finding remains unchanged. The feature-enabled binary accepts `reason ... el` and dispatches `classify`, but `cmd_reason` still advertises only `<rdfs|owl|n3>`, while the top-level usage still omits both `reason` and feature-gated `classify`. Because the documented CLI intentionally has no `--help`, these usage errors are the command-discovery contract. The new subprocess suite still does not cover either stale path. The EL differential and classification-path tests otherwise exercise the real binary paths.
